action: Upgrade self-managed GitLab to 19.5.6, 19.4.8 or 19.3.9, matching your release line, and read the GitLab patch release notes linked from the advisory for the flaws fixed.
exec: Routine patch notice for self-managed GitLab; no exploitation is reported in the Canadian advisory.
plain: Canada's cyber agency told organisations that run their own GitLab code-hosting servers to install the latest patch release.

key_findings: Affected: GitLab before 19.3.9, before 19.4.8 and before 19.5.6.
The advisory links to the GitLab patch release for 19.5.6, 19.4.8 and 19.3.9.
The page names no CVE identifiers and gives no description of the flaws.
The advisory makes no statement about exploitation.
recommendations: Review the GitLab patch release and release notes linked from the advisory.
Apply the necessary updates as they become available.

summary: Cyber Centre advisory AV26-1168 says GitLab is affected by vulnerabilities in versions before 19.3.9, 19.4.8 and 19.5.6 and points to GitLab's patch release notes. The page names no CVEs, gives no description of the flaws and does not say whether any is being exploited.
title: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security issues GitLab advisory AV26-1168 for patch releases 19.5.6, 19.4.8, 19.3.9

validation.note: Reviewed against the original Canadian Centre for Cyber Security document.

review.note: Compared number, date, affected versions, no CVEs and no exploitation statement against the Cyber Centre page
